questions.question: What does chapter 26 set before Israel?
options: Penalties for many forbidden sexual relations
Blessings for obedience and curses for sin
Duties assigned to the serving priests
New offerings for the sacred festivals
questions.answer: Blessings for obedience and curses for sin

questions.question: What did God promise if Israel obeyed him?
options: A temple of stone in Jerusalem
A king to rule over the nations

questions.question: God promised to walk among them and be their God if they kept his covenant.
